pairs.why: A's drums turn softly with broad gentle sheen like the real kit, while B has glossy white hot spots and a shiny, specular stage rim that reads plastic.
B's larger posts and planks have clearer light-to-shadow turns and a contact shadow where the posts meet the water, closer to the real dock's modeled forms.
A's navy body turns more softly with a muted sheen, whereas B adds sharper glossy highlights on the yellow knobs and brackets.
A has a soft floor reflection and contact shadow under the console like the real card, while B's console is more evenly lit and floats with less grounding.
A's lower foliage drops into a darker shadow side with a cast shadow on the pavement, nearer the real topiary's deeper form shadow, though both have over-bright yellow highlights.
B's straps and soles carry a broad soft sheen and gentle underside shading similar to the real sandals, while A reads flatter.
A has a broad soft sheen on the panels and a soft warm cast shadow like the real ball, while B has small sharp hot spots and a harder contact shadow.
Both gloves show similar wrinkled folds and comparable shadow depth, so shading gives no reason to prefer one.
